notes: Where ward-round patients wait on the ward, and which 3D model plays each one. Staging only: no clinical, story or save data. Patients still needing a plan sit on the bed in the patient rooms, oldest admission first; when a plan is accepted the next patient takes the room. Positions are zone coordinates (metres); yaw turns the actor's -Z facing (90 faces the room door, -X). A case without a model here is seen in the EHR only.
